{"id":"project-LICHEN-1www.1","title":"snprintf truncation unchecked in lichen_ipv6_addr_to_str","description":"Location: firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ipv6_addr.c:189-199

snprintf() return value is checked for negative (encoding error) but NOT for truncation. When ret >= buflen, output is truncated but function returns success (0).

What goes wrong: If buflen shrinks or format changes, truncated addresses would be logged/used without error. The pre-check (buflen < LICHEN_IPV6_ADDR_STR_LEN) mitigates for well-behaved callers, but function contract should be robust.

Fix: Add check for (size_t)ret >= buflen and return -ENOSPC.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-06-27T21:41:36.981225Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-27T22:03:24.968821Z","closed_at":"2026-06-27T22:03:24.968821Z","close_reason":"fixed","labels":["c-standards","error-handling","owner-reserved","review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-1www.1","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-1www","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-06-27T21:41:36.981702Z"}]}

new_value: Defect already eliminated structurally before this session: lichen_ipv6_addr_to_str no longer uses snprintf (the code cited at lines 189-199 no longer exists; current impl in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c hand-formats hex digits after a buflen < LICHEN_IPV6_ADDR_STR_LEN pre-check returning -EINVAL, writing exactly 39 chars + NUL, so truncation-with-success is impossible by construction). Completed this bead by locking the contract with tests: added truncation-boundary coverage to lichen/tests/pubkey_to_iid/main.c (exact-size 40-byte buffer produces the documented uncompressed form of fe80::1234:5678:9abc:def0 with canary bytes intact; buflen 39 and 1 return -EINVAL with NUL-terminated empty; buflen 0 returns -EINVAL and leaves the buffer untouched; NULL addr/buf return -EINVAL). Independent oracle: expected string per the documented 39+1 hex format applied to known RFC 4291 bytes. Verified: host cmake build + ctest pass under UBSan; -fsyntax-only of the touched main.c clean in POSIX, stub-Zephyr, and bare-metal (-nostdinc) modes. -ENOSPC per the original prescription is moot since no snprintf remains; contract stays -EINVAL as documented.
